title: Otolith organ of vestibular system.jpg
author: NASA
caption: Diagram of the vestibular otolith organs (utricle and saccule) with otoconia responding to linear acceleration and gravity.
alt_text: Schematic of otolith membrane hair cells deflected by otoconia under gravitational and linear acceleration vectors.
clinical_relevance: Otolith organs adapt to microgravity and experience re-loading during gravity-well entry, driving neurovestibular motion sickness.
